reason: The original scorer only recognized the legacy digest-modulo split. The final blind set was intentionally frozen by a separate seeded, source-only manifest, so the scorer now validates the exact manifest SHA256 set instead. A later integrity-only change added a fail-closed CLI mode requiring that manifest, and the NCS MCP HTTP transport was hardened without changing semantic output. After the one-time comparison, exact ordinal-unit decoration resolution was added for labels such as an official detail followed by a numbered official unit in parentheses. That semantic mapping change affects one frozen record, so the original result is retained only as the pre-change append-only result and no independent blind claim is made for the current code. The deployable catalogs were subsequently restricted to usage_yn=Y so 15 inactive details and their 153 units cannot be presented as current official data; none of the 36 frozen records use those inactive detail codes. A 2026-08-25 15:05 KST non-independent full-corpus recheck compared all scorer-relevant fields for the exact 36 manifest hashes against the preserved baseline benchmark and confirmed that only the already-disclosed record changed. Operational ZIP completeness increased one non-frozen archive from 12 to 23 processed members without changing its scored classification. The final v1.4.12 operational pass additionally rejects forged ZIP streams and pathological HTML/Markdown structures, retains request slots across detached nested MCP workers, bounds and cancels remote fan-out safely, and binds gold scoring to the APP_VERSION, code, and catalog actually loaded by the loopback parser. A configured-MCP 206-document rerun and selected/full active KSA audits found no new non-timing drift or contract failure.

Later operational hardening clamps Kordoc timeouts to the request deadline, replaces repeated section-label and duplicate scans with equivalent indexed lookups, requires printable strong bridge shared secrets, verifies that the configured Ed25519 private key derives the public key pinned by the bridge, and signs a declared body hash that the bridge verifies before and after reading the body. v1.4.12 adds bounded HTML/Markdown table, line, candidate-cell, and composite-segment budgets with early rejection of pathological inputs while preserving all 206 stored documents. The scorer now preflights and enforces a local-only parser policy before private bytes are sent, while remote bridge evidence is bound to the current Vercel deployment identity. The append-only stored-JD blind result is not revised or re-claimed after these semantic changes
